background_image_description: Subtle warm off‑white paper texture with fine horizontal fiber lines and light noise uniformly across the entire canvas.

nodes.asset_description: Photographic eucalyptus branch cluster entering from the upper-right corner, with multiple elongated oval leaves in gradients of medium to dark green and lighter lime highlights on the edges. Thin brown-green stems curve diagonally toward the center; the foliage overlaps slightly into the canvas while the rightmost edges are cropped.

Photographic eucalyptus sprig arrangement anchored at the lower-left corner. Several long matte leaves in muted blue‑green tones with slimmer bright green young leaves extend diagonally toward the center-right. Stems are thin and branching; the bottom and left edges are cropped by the canvas.
